results.name: environment
results.detail: JDK 21.0.8 providers=SunEC version 21/SunJCE version 21 (DESKTOP JDK, NOT AndroidKeyStore)

results.name: jca.ecdh.leadingZero.width
results.detail: SunEC KeyAgreement.generateSecret() returned the full 32 bytes including the leading 0x00.

results.name: jca.publicKeyEncoding
results.detail: X509EncodedKeySpec(prefix||SEC1 point) re-encodes to the identical 91-byte SPKI: true; getEncoded() is SPKI, so the same prefix rule works on Java.

results.name: jca.ecdsa.rejectsRawP1363
results.detail: SHA256withECDSA rejects a bare P-1363 signature: true (conversion is mandatory)

results.name: jca.ecdsa.webToJca
results.detail: WebCrypto P-1363 signature, converted to DER, verified by SunEC: true

results.name: jca.ecdsa.nativeEncoding
results.detail: SunEC emits X9.62 DER (71 bytes, first 0x30), NOT P-1363.

results.name: jca.aesGcm
results.detail: SunJCE returns ciphertext||tag (48 bytes) identical to the WebCrypto vector: true

results.name: jca.hkdf
results.detail: RFC 5869 HKDF over javax.crypto.Mac matches the WebCrypto vector: true (JDK 21 has no built-in HKDF; a KDF must be supplied)

results.name: jca.glk2.webToJca
results.detail: signature=true unwrappedScopeKeyMatches=true (envelope sealed by WebCrypto, opened by JCA)

results.name: jca.glk2.tamperRejected
